g.text: ST-1112 / ST-1113: float traps with integral strainer and test valve; separator high-level alarm: MAC supplier (D-065)
E-1102 / E-1103: integral moisture separators, drains via traps (D-064)
C-1101: its condensate (S3C, ~0.6 m3/h) leaves with the sump water via LV-1106 (D-064)
